name: テキスト圧縮比
description: 使用します data compression algorithms を測定するために text redundancy and predictability as indicators of AI generation.
useCase: AI生成テキストの検出 through lower information density and higher compressibility
mechanism: Compresses the input text using lossless algorithms (gzip, zlib, LZ77) and computes the 圧縮率 (compressed size / original size). AI生成の text typically compresses more efficiently due to higher regularity, more repetitive パターン, and lower information エントロピー compared to 人間のテキスト. The method also 分析する the 圧縮率 of sliding windows を検出するために segments with varying compressibility—a sign of mixed human/AI authorship.
source: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024) - Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education: A Comparative Study for ChatGPT Cases, IEEE Access
algorithm: Multi-Algorithm Compression + Ratio Analysis + Sliding Window Segmentation
parameters: Algorithms: gzip-9/zlib/brotli, Window: 200-500 chars sliding, Metrics: global ratio, segment ratios, ratio 分散, Min text: 200 words
strengths:
• トレーニングデータ不要 (unsupervised)
• Language and model agnostic
• Extremely fast computation
• Captures information-theoretic properties
limitations:
• Lower 精度 on short texts
• Technical text with repeated terms compresses well naturally
• Depends on compression algorithm choice
• Not sensitive to semantic-level パターン

references.title: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024). Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education. IEEE Access.
Benedetto, D. et al. (2002). Language Trees and Zipping. Physical Review Letters.
Mireshghallah, F. et al. (2024). Smaller Language Models are Better Black-box Machine-Generated Text Detectors. EACL.
